prompt:
Fix the snippet snippets/product-tag-pills.liquid. It lists a product's tags. It currently prints every tag, including internal tags, without escaping, and it always prints the list wrapper. Inputs (top-level variables only, there is no section.settings): - tags: array of non-empty strings, never null, possibly empty. Rules: - A tag is internal, and must be skipped, when its very first character is an underscore "_". Tags that contain an underscore elsewhere, such as "new_arrival" or "A_", are visible. A tag that starts with a space followed by an underscore, such as " _x", is also visible. Do not strip tags. - Visible tags are output in their original order. Skipping an internal tag must not stop processing of the tags after it. - Each visible tag is output as
  • TAG
    • , where TAG is HTML-escaped with the escape filter. - The list items are wrapped in
      ...
    . - If there are no visible tags, because the array is empty or every tag is internal, output nothing at all (empty string). In that case do not output an empty ul. - Do not emit whitespace or newlines between or around tags. Example: ["_sync","Linen"] renders exactly
    • Linen
    Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/product-tag-pills.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
